title: 3-day full-body strength maintenance
author: Neil Workout Bot
notes: Goal: maintain strength. Three full-body gym sessions a week (e.g. Mon/Wed/Fri), alternating A-B-A one week and B-A-B the next; keep up the daily dog walks on the other days. Every session: warm-up of 8-10 min static bike (easy, then moderate) plus 1-2 light sets of the first lift; cool-down of 8-10 min easy bike plus 5 min stretching (hips, hamstrings, chest, calves). Rest 90 s-2 min between sets. End each set with about 2 reps in reserve. Progression: when you hit the top of the rep range on all sets with good form, add the smallest weight increment next time. Optional extras: calf raises 2 x 12-15 and single-leg balance 30 s per leg. If a day moves, keep the A/B order and leave at least a day between sessions.
